description: Daily Nikkei 225 futures (large/mini/micro) night- and day-session OHLC, volume and settlement, extracted from JPX's official daily derivatives report. Used by the ON1 forward paper tracker (docs/PREREG_on1_forward.md, src/bot/jpx/on1_executor.py). Distinct from schema/nk225_events.json (index constituent add/delete events).
source: JPX official daily report (free, published next business day ~9:00 JST): jpx.co.jp/automation/markets/statistics-derivatives/daily/json/daily_report_YYYYMM.json -> Daily_Report_OSE_YYYYMMDD.zip -> sif_dyr_YYYYMMDD.pdf, parsed for the three Nikkei 225 futures lines -- see scripts/fetch_jpx_daily.py.
retention: appended forward, idempotent: a (date, product, month) row already present is never rewritten. Run daily from deploy/fetch_all.bat, fetching only missing dates within a trailing window (default 7 days).

settlement.meaning: settlement price for the trade date

known_defects: data_quality.py's TS_CANDIDATES recognizes the literal column name 'date' but this file's date is a bare YYYYMMDD integer rather than an ISO string -- parse_ts handles the 8-digit form, but double check gap/non-monotonic results here rather than trusting them blindly

this file interleaves three independent series (large/mini/micro contract sizes, and rolling contract months within each) -- group_by above splits gap/non-monotonic/extreme_return checks by (product, month) so a normal cross-series jump is not misread as one series moving

paper_logs/nk225_sessions.csv is the owner-PC operational copy this checkout mirrors; data/jpx_daily/nk225_sessions.csv is this checkout's own copy (built independently by the same fetch script) -- the two are not guaranteed to be byte-identical, only same-shaped
